steps.en: Install the CLI and point it at an LLM endpoint
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，配上模型端点

steps.en: Run it on your working tree, a branch range, or one commit
steps.zh: 对着工作区、分支区间或单个提交跑

steps.en: Picks which files to review, bundles related ones, matches a rule per file
steps.zh: 挑出该审的文件、把相关文件打包、给每个文件匹配规则

component.zh: 文件筛选 + 规则解析

steps.en: Each bundle goes to the review agent, which reads whole files and searches the repo
steps.zh: 每个文件包交给 review agent，它可以读整份文件、在仓库里搜

steps.en: A positioning module pins each finding to a real line, then prints text or JSON
steps.zh: 定位模块把每条发现钉到真实行号，再输出文本或 JSON

steps.en: In CI, parse the JSON and post the comments to the PR/MR
steps.zh: CI 里解析 JSON，把评论贴回 PR/MR

value.en: You stop coaxing a prompt: findings land on real lines, at the project's reported ~1/9 of a general-purpose agent's tokens
value.zh: 不用再哄 prompt：发现落在真实行号上，项目自测的 token 消耗约为通用 agent 的九分之一

sources: README (install: npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review; ocr review workspace/range/commit; --format json; Git >= 2.41)
pages/src/content/docs/en/integrations/ci.md (GitHub Actions recipe examples/github_actions/ocr-review.yml: parse JSON, post inline comments)
pages/src/content/docs/en/review-rules.md (six-gate file filtering, four-layer rule priority chain, positioning/reflection modules)
